candidates.change_summary: Remove the guard that reverts when already initialized so SetMinSum can overwrite MinSum after initialization (delete the if(intitalized)revert(); check).
Drop the nonReentrant_ modifier so SetMinSum can be reentered and thus allow potential different observable MinSum when reentered during SetMinSum execution.

Change nonReentrant_ to set locked_ after function body (move setting locked_ = true to after _ to invert the lock behavior, allowing reentrant calls to observe different MinSum), i.e., acquire lock after execution instead of before.
Replace the revert-on-initialized guard with only allowing SetMinSum when already initialized (inverts the condition), so SetMinSum can only be called after Initialized() was set true.
Remove the guard that prevents SetMinSum after initialization, allowing MinSum to be set even when intitalized is true (delete the revert check).
Remove the reentrancy protection by replacing the modifier body to no-op, allowing SetMinSum to be callable without the nonReentrant_ guard effect.
Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier to remove setting locked_ back to false after the function body, leaving locked_ permanently true once a guarded function is called.
Replace the body of SetLogFile to omit the check and assignment, instead setting Log to the zero address cast, changing the stored Log value after the call.
Replace the assignment to Log with assigning the caller (msg.sender) cast to LogFile, so SetLogFile stores msg.sender instead of the provided _log.
Replace the body to set intitalized = false instead of true so calling Initialized() clears the flag.
Replace the body to toggle intitalized (invert its boolean) so the value after the call differs when it was true.
Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier body to not reset the lock after execution (remove unlocked reset), which can prevent subsequent Initialized() from running and thus change observed intitalized.
Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier body to require locked_ (inverse check), making functions guarded by it revert when unlocked and succeed only when locked — changing ability to call Initialized().
